text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: …Hey, check it out.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Oh, I know her! That's Happy Meek!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Her trainer's Kiryuin, one of the best in the scene. Even Trainer Kashimoto recognizes her talents.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: She looks the spacey type, but she's not. Don't let your guard down.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Ha ha ha! Well I say bring it on! If she can give me a challenge, that's all the—

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Hm? Where'd she go?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Huh? I swear she was just there…

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Spying… How thrilling…

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Whoooa!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: When did you…

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: I heard you say… Trainer Kiryuin is one of the best trainers… So I thought you two must be… spying on me.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Why would we be spying?!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Let me tell you something, we're learning from the best—Trainer Kashimoto.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yeah, so we don't need to spy on you! We're more than capable of beating you!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Tch… My trainer is… just as amazing.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: …I've learned a lot from her. She's… always thinking of new training courses for me.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: And so does Trainer Kashimoto. She monitors our conditions every day and adjusts our training schedule accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: Trainer Kiryuin is… very athletic. She can do… parkour.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Haha, don't think we have a rebuttal for that one!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: W-wait, though. Trainer Kashimoto recently mastered doing forward tumbles! One at a time, at least.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text: Um… I'm sorry for all the trouble Meek caused!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: No… I also apologize.
